cases.sentence: не в ярости упрекай меня, и не во ___ наказывай.
cases.translation: Don't rebuke me in your wrath, neither chasten me in your hot displeasure.
cases.explain: The preposition во (in) with the meaning of emotion or state governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: стрелы Твои пронзили меня, и ___ Твоя на мне тяжела.
cases.translation: For your arrows have pierced me, your hand presses hard on me.
cases.explain: The noun рука is the nominative subject of the verb is (understood): your hand presses.

cases.translation: There is no soundness in my flesh.
cases.explain: The genitive case is used after the negative construction 'there is no (нет)'.

cases.sentence: Грехи мои меня поглотили, они как ___ отягощают меня.
cases.translation: My iniquities have gone over my head. As a heavy burden, they are too heavy for me.
cases.explain: The nominative case is used for the predicate nominative after the verb 'like'.

cases.sentence: Мои друзья и те, кто любят меня, из-за ___ меня избегают.
cases.translation: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my plague.
cases.explain: The preposition из-за (because of) governs the genitive plural case.

cases.sentence: А я, как глухой, не слышу, как немой, не размыкаю ___.
cases.translation: But I, as a deaf man, don't hear. I am as a mute man who doesn't open his mouth.
cases.explain: The genitive case is used in the negative construction 'not opening (from) the mouth'.

cases.sentence: Не дай им торжествовать передо ___ когда мои ноги колеблются.
cases.translation: Don't let them gloat over me when my foot slips.
cases.explain: The preposition передо (before/in front of) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Злом воздают мне за ___, враждуют со мной за то, что добру я следую.
cases.translation: They who render evil for good are also adversaries to me.
cases.explain: The verb воздают (render/give) with за takes the accusative case.

reading.ru: Ведь стрелы Твои пронзили меня, и рука Твоя на мне тяжела.
reading.question: What is the psalmist experiencing as a result of God's judgment?
options: God's arrows have pierced him and His hand is heavy upon him
reading.correct: God's arrows have pierced him and His hand is heavy upon him
reading.explain: The text states стрелы Твои пронзили меня и рука Твоя на мне тяжела (Your arrows have pierced me and Your hand is heavy upon me).

reading.ru: Грехи мои меня поглотили, они как бремя отягощают меня.
reading.question: How does the psalmist describe his sins?
options: As a heavy burden that weighs him down
reading.correct: As a heavy burden that weighs him down
reading.explain: The text says Грехи мои меня поглотили, они как бремя отягощают меня (My sins have overwhelmed me; they are a heavy burden weighing me down).

reading.ru: Мои друзья и те, кто любят меня, из-за язв меня избегают.
reading.question: How do the psalmist's friends respond to his suffering?
options: They avoid him because of his wounds
reading.correct: They avoid him because of his wounds
reading.explain: The text says Мои друзья и те, кто любят меня, из-за язв меня избегают (My friends and loved ones avoid me because of my wounds).

reading.ru: А я, как глухой, не слышу, как немой, не размыкаю уст.
reading.question: How does the psalmist respond to the accusations against him?
options: Like a deaf person who doesn't hear and a mute who doesn't speak
He seeks witnesses to defend him
reading.correct: Like a deaf person who doesn't hear and a mute who doesn't speak
reading.explain: The text says я как глухой, не слышу, как немой, не размыкаю уст (I am like a deaf man who doesn't hear and a mute man who doesn't open his mouth).

reading.ru: Я признаю мое беззаконие и скорблю о моем грехе.
reading.question: What does the psalmist declare regarding his sin?
options: He acknowledges his transgression and grieves for his sin
He blames others for his sin
reading.correct: He acknowledges his transgression and grieves for his sin
reading.explain: The text states Я признаю мое беззаконие и скорблю о моем грехе (I acknowledge my transgression and grieve for my sin).

reading.ru: Господи, не оставь меня, не удаляйся от меня, мой Бог, поспеши мне на помощь, Владыка мой Спаситель.
reading.question: What is the psalmist's urgent plea to God?
options: Don't abandon him and come quickly to his aid
Take him away from the world
reading.correct: Don't abandon him and come quickly to his aid
reading.explain: The text pleads: не оставь меня, не удаляйся от меня, поспеши мне на помощь (Do not forsake me, do not be far from me, come quickly to my aid).
